[Verse 1 | center-mixed dry vocal | percussive rhyme delivery | low piano & string stabs | heavy stomp groove]
It’s three a.m., my eyes wide, sweat stickin’ to the blinds  
Creepin’ down the hallway, breathin’ in the bleach and turpentine  
Bags under my eyelids, wired, mind’s a landmine  
Every footstep’s a warning, blood crusted under the nightlight  
Flick my Bic, see the flicker in the kitchen, somethin’ twitchin’  
Blades in the sink, dishes still drippin’, skin itchin’  
Fist clinchin’, got a Polaroid of you, lips stitched in  
You shoulda listened, now I’m sittin’ here, scripts missin’  
Ain’t no escape, I mapped your house, the locks, the routes, the patterns  
Watchin’ you through a cracked screen, hackin’ passwords, laughin’  
Every tap on the glass, you gasp, you can’t relax  
You hear my voice in the static, but you’ll never hear me ask  

[Pre-Chorus | tense string build | doubled vocal lines | rising snare rolls]
Sleep with one eye open, countin’ every second tickin’  
Your closet’s got a secret, and I’m the one who’s livin’ in it  
You check the locks, but I already been in  
You pray for dawn, but I love when the night’s infinite  

[Chorus | layered hook vocals | minor-key orchestral hits | sub-bass drop]
You can run, but I’m inside your head,  
Every creak in the floor, every word that you said  
You can hide, but you’re beggin’ for death  
I’m the reason you sweat, I’m the voice in your bed  
Turn the lights on, I’m still in the dark  
You can scream, but nobody’s hearin’ your heart  
I’m the knife in the drawer, the face in the park  
You’re not alone, I’m the teeth in the bark  

[Verse 2 | dry rapid-fire vocal | cinematic string stabs | heavy snare]
Broke in your basement, draggin’ chains on the cement  
Breathin’ on the window, drawin’ names in the steam vent  
You hear footsteps, it’s me, I ain’t leavin’  
Check your phone, see my face in the screen, you ain’t dreamin’  
Snap a rib, snap a pic, got your hair in a fist  
Got a list, every sin, every time you resist  
You panic, I vanish, reappear in the attic  
Runnin’ bathwater cold, and I’m laughin’ at the static  
I’m the itch you can’t scratch, the crack in your ceiling  
I’m the chill in your spine, the sick in your feeling  
You pray for a savior, but I’m all you believe in  
I’m the nightmare you married, and you’re never leavin’  

[Bridge | whispered doubled vocals | minimal piano | tense strings]
Don’t bother callin’ for help, I cut the line  
You can beg, you can plead, but your soul’s already mine  
You can lock every door, you can board every blind  
But I’m breathin’ on your neck, and I’m always behind  

[Chorus | layered hook vocals | orchestral hits | sub-bass drop]
You can run, but I’m inside your head,  
Every creak in the floor, every word that you said  
You can hide, but you’re beggin’ for death  
I’m the reason you sweat, I’m the voice in your bed  
Turn the lights on, I’m still in the dark  
You can scream, but nobody’s hearin’ your heart  
I’m the knife in the drawer, the face in the park  
You’re not alone, I’m the teeth in the bark  

[Outro | single vocal | sparse piano | distant string drone]
It’s too late for regrets, too late for the prayers  
You’re trapped in my world, and nobody cares  
I’ll be here in the silence, when you’re gaspin’ for air  
When you close your eyes, just know I’m still there

[Chorus | layered hook vocal delays | low piano stabs | sub-bass swell | dry vocal doubling]

This ain't a nightmare, this is me wide awake,  
Claws out, you shiver, I salivate,  
Every step you make, I navigate,  
You're in my world now, checkmate.

Neighbors peek through the blinds, catch a glimpse,  
I flash a grin, teeth grit, slit the suspense,  
Midnight ritual, clinical, cynical,  
Tie the cord tight, make it look typical,  
Stare in your eyes, see the fear ripple,  
I got you cornered, panic's habitual,  
Crimson on the doorknob, prints on the floor,  
I study every movement, hunger for more,  
Sick fascination, fascination with gore,  
You beg for a savior, I settle the score,  
Breathe in the terror, savor the stench,  
I'm a product of the dark, born in the trench,  
Every scar on my wrist, every fucked up inch,  
Is a line in my script, every plot gets clinched,  
No remorse, just force, this is therapy,  
I'm the reason you sweat, can't sleep, no clarity,  
Hate in my chest, but I love the disparity,  
Watch you fall apart, that's my parody.

[Chorus | layered hook vocal delays | low piano stabs | sub-bass swell | dry vocal doubling]
This ain't a nightmare, this is me wide awake,  
Doors locked, you're trapped, can't escape,  
Every breath you take, I calibrate,  
No prayers, no hope, just fate,  
This ain't a nightmare, this is me wide awake,  
Claws out, you shiver, I salivate,  
Every step you make, I navigate,  
You're in my world now, checkmate.

[Outro | whispered vocal layers | strings fade | sub-bass pulse | slow decay]
Keep your eyes shut, count to ten,  
When you open 'em up, I'm there again,  
Heartbeat thumpin', sweat on your chin,  
Game over, you lose, that's how it ends.
